imply_option("BROWSER_CHROME_URL", "chrome://messenger/content/extensionPopup.xhtml")
# Include the DevTools client, not just the server (which is the default)
imply_option("MOZ_DEVTOOLS", "all")

imply_option("MOZ_PLACES", True)
imply_option("MOZ_SERVICES_HEALTHREPORT", True)
imply_option("MOZ_DEDICATED_PROFILES", True)
imply_option("MOZ_BLOCK_PROFILE_DOWNGRADE", True)
imply_option("MOZ_PROFILE_MIGRATOR", True)

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The four 2024 configure ports moved BROWSER_CHROME_URL, MOZ_DEVTOOLS and MOZ_PROFILE_MIGRATOR from shell configuration to imply_option and replaced environment mutation for source identity with declared dependencies. Current mail/moz.configure still sets the extension popup URL, requests the DevTools client with all, and enables the profile migrator. A packaging failure reported MOZ_SOURCE_REPO missing after the Gecko migration. Inspect the consumer and dependency graph when moving a build value; a copied shell assignment may no longer reach it. This study did not configure, package or build Thunderbird.
title: Declare Thunderbird build options through configure dependencies
